description: Land Title Settlement Department - Koholankala, Hambantota D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830109 (23/1080)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details (mostly "The State" with one private owner), and land registration particulars. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land title settlement and registration processes, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
